_note: NAMES IN ANOTHER LANGUAGE, read by pages/build.py for every page. Wherever one of them stands in a displayed sentence, the build sets it in a span that is never hyphenated, and marks its language where one is given, so a screen reader says it right. German text hyphenates on a phone, and a holder's name must not break as 'Biblio-teca'. A name is matched as written here, whole words only, and a genitive s may follow it. Give 'lang' only where a screen reader has a voice for it (it, fr, es, en): a Latin or mixed name gets none and is only kept whole. 'person' marks a person's full name: it never breaks across two lines either. A wing's own name is not listed here: the build takes it from the wing's entry. Add a name when a new page brings one.
